selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing method gap because a failed run currently entangles the paper mechanism with the artifact and interface needed to execute it on the locked task. Decompose-and-delegate closes that residual by compiling mechanism and execution-contract content into independently checkable artifacts, crossing them orthogonally, and routing every cell to the locked runner and scorer rather than predicting utility from other tasks.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This sibling shares the anchor's four-cell execution ledger, so task outcome, contract validity, adaptation actions, resource cost, and locked regressions are emitted by the same verifier-closed runs rather than by a separate study. Decompose-and-delegate makes that typed ledger load-bearing and lets within-task cell contrasts attribute local net benefit to mechanism content, contract completion, or their interaction.

deliverable_coverage: method - the anchor gap's decompose_and_delegate pattern yields the runnable mechanism-by-contract cell compiler, locked-runner verification loop, and local four-class diagnostic.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: the candidate conditions on the user's current locked task and makes no claim about whether any generated or benchmark task represents a wider target distribution.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: cross-family calibration and prediction would be a separate paper; this candidate reports only a local four-cell diagnosis for the task actually executed.
